ordered_priorities: Independent effective geometry and actual solver normals audit
Control-volume momentum accounting with frozen-source instrumentation and non-perturbation check
First/second-order same-mesh comparison, then broader refined mesh diagnostics

fixed.initial_condition: Original uniform depth; variants explicitly declared only if audit establishes a reason

rule: No fitted geometry, roughness or timing changes. Preserve working corpus inputs and reviewed anchors. Instrumentation may not be interpreted until equivalence against the frozen solver is checked.

control_volumes: Building reach centroid x=[1.5,4.5], all y
terms: Total numerical interior flux (pressure, advective transport, dissipation)
momentum_receipts.integrator: Both RK2 Euler stages weighted 1/2; accepted state compared independently with saved fields. Any RK final reset or other residual is reported, not silently assigned.

instrumentation_equivalence_acceptance: All saved depths and velocities bit-identical for frozen short vs archived long, audit-disabled vs frozen, enabled vs disabled, before interpreting receipts.

phase3_declared_cases.name: order1-30
phase3_declared_cases.change: RECONSTRUCTION_ORDER 2 to 1; native option changes spatial reconstruction and RK2 to Euler, hence combined method-order sensitivity.

phase3_declared_cases.name: muscl-off-30
phase3_declared_cases.change: Disable spatial MUSCL reconstruction via existing environment switch; retain RK2 and identical mesh/input except 30 s duration.

phase3_declared_cases.name: broad005-30
phase3_declared_cases.change: Drawing/terrain unchanged; .05 m target over full reservoir, throat, gate and building to x=8 with 2 m graded transition, .1 m background.

adaptive_followup.name: broad005-muscloff-30
adaptive_followup.trigger: Coarse MUSCL-off with unchanged RK2 closely reproduces native order-1 G2 depth/speed and reduces measured errors.
adaptive_followup.change: Same already-prepared broad mesh/input and RK2 as broad005-30; only existing MUSCL_OFF switch enabled.
adaptive_followup.purpose: Test refinement response of reconstruction-disabled solution; do not select by recovered-marker fit or claim convergence from two resolutions.
